cohort.order: source_manifest.json participant_file_ids; literal decimal subject_id mapping from its roi_timeseries members
cohort.dimensions_status: Original-source structural inspection confirmed 40 files, each 196x200, all finite, before connectivity and endpoints
cohort.analysis_membership: fixed40 only; phenotype does not select/exclude people
cohort.timing_authority: TR unverified and explicitly unknown; no duration inferred from frame count; frame-indexed calculation only
cohort.phenotype_token_authority: Literal authenticated source tokens, not acquisition terminology inferred from undocumented coding

interpretation.estimand: fixed-cohort selection-dependent signed later-minus-earlier mean Fisher-z
interpretation.equivalence_margin_label: inherited pedagogical Fisher-z margin, not validated neural/clinical minimum effect
forbidden_claims: sign reversal proves no temporal process

source_parse.input: original decimal .1D text to float64, not legacy float32 NPZ
source_parse.source_header_and_phenotype_fields: Original tab-separated #1..#200 positional header; all original phenotype header/1112 rows retained; exact selected joins recorded without selection or exclusion by phenotype
source_parse.digest_authority: Member SHA256 digests bind captured original bytes; derivative S3 null versions are mutable, ETag is an If-Match token not presumed MD5; source_manifest records provenance
source_parse.license_authority: See SOURCE_NOTICE.md and source_manifest.json; non-commercial research and source attribution/registration/share-alike terms are not waived by public S3 access

split.odd_middle_row: excluded from halves, included in full run

support.exact_constant_rule: all entries equal -> mean first entry, SD0
support.nonconstant_mean: math.fsum in original frame order / segment length
support.nonconstant_sd: sqrt(sum squared centered deviations / segment length); stable scaled reduction allowed
support.rule: strict SD>1e-8 for all40 x first/second/full
support.threshold_meaning: operational numerical criterion in existing source units
support.common_mask_count_authority: Recompute operative fsum/scaled-SD support from authenticated source; no required retained-ROI count or exclusions

connectivity.pearson: Centered vectors normalized by stable L2, then their dot product; scale-normalized evaluation avoids multiplying tiny norms
connectivity.serialized_fisher_cap: permit source-fidelity rounding bound; no infinity

selections.rank: decreasing signed accepted score, exact ties by increasing canonical original ROI pair
selections.reverse: own second segment; delta sign remains second-first
selections.independent: fsum accepted full segment over all39 other people in canonical cohort order /39
selections.training_membership: all other39 exactly; serialized training list order irrelevant

random.draws: one choice(E,size=k,replace=False) call per canonical subject, no intervening draws

selections.serialized_edge_indices: positions in submitted NPZ edge axis; remap to original pair before set checks
selections.first_mean: math.fsum(accepted first z on selected set)/k
selections.second_mean: math.fsum(accepted second z on selected set)/k

source_guard.purpose: conditioned primitive fidelity and source-defined inference support, not endpoint targets
source_guard.centers: accurate scalar mean; stable scaled L2; exact constants centered to0
source_guard.edge_vector_scope: each subject x first/second/full across E edges
source_guard.correlation_activity: E>=2 and both source first/second centered norms>0
source_guard.inactive_correlation: null even if accepted z jitter has variance
source_guard.selected_set_specific_delta_anchor: compute unrounded source second-mean minus first-mean on the accepted selected pair sets; never substitute source-selected sets

delta_resolution_convention.arithmetic: stable scaled norms/comparisons; explicit underflow/nonfinite handling
delta_resolution_convention.authority: public cancellation-resolution convention, not universal FC solver error bound

source_guard.accepted_descriptive_statistics_when_sou: mean,SD,SE describe accepted rows only; cannot activate inference
source_guard.conditioning_scope: Selected-set-specific source anchors and primitive fidelity; no source endpoint or selected-set equality target

own_replay.forward_linear_coherence: sum bounds for accepted first_mean,second_mean,delta; compare delta with second-first
own_replay.summary_authority: accepted CSV deltas; accepted per-person source-activity-guarded reliability receipts
own_replay.sample_sd: centered sum of squares /39 then sqrt; stable scaled evaluation
own_replay.t: accepted mean / accepted SE, only when source-active and finite positive SE
own_replay.n_negative: count accepted delta<0 exactly, no epsilon and no canonical count
own_replay.numerical_undefined: null inferential fields plus explicit numerical_underflow/nonfinite status; never NaN/Infinity
own_replay.probability_underflow: finite computed0 allowed, not asserted exact real probability

tost.equivalent: p_tost<alpha from unrounded own replay, not displayed p or source Boolean
tost.source_inactive_or_undefined: all p fields and Boolean null
tost.exact_margin_boundary: use the same equations if active; inactive remains null

own_replay.evidence_duplicate_means: receipts against accepted-NPZ replay only; CSV means remain group authority; sum error bounds if crosscompared

reliability.pearson: accepted first/second edge vectors under source activity guard
reliability.spearman: Pearson of average ranks of accepted first/second values; exact ties only
reliability.rank_tie_sensitivity: disclosed; no source coefficient target or rounding-based stabilization
reliability.own_arithmetic_undefined: Collapsed accepted correlation support is invalid; no inferred correlation from source-inactive inputs
reliability.group_mean: all40 only; if any undefined correlation, its group mean null and report n_defined/n_undefined

connectivity_arrays.common_roi_mask: [200] exact source mask, aligned to roi_ids
connectivity_arrays.edge_roi_j: [E] original IDs, all common pairs exactly once

artifacts.selection_evidence: fcstab-selection-v3; task_id,status complete,pins{source_manifest_sha256,method_contract_sha256,output_schema_sha256,subject_ids_sha256},n_edges,k,seed0,subjects[40]. Each subject has subject_id,training_subject_ids,four scheme_edge_indices,means{scheme:{first,second}},reliability{overlap,edge_pearson,edge_spearman,status}. No additional common-ROI field required.
artifacts.summary: fcstab-summary-v3; task_id,status complete,same four pins,n_subjects40,cohort,source_files,source_observed,software,four selection_schemes,equivalence,forward_top_decile_connectivity,reliability,source_inference_support{scheme:{status}}. Exact nested typed fields in /app/output_schema.json; numeric support diagnostics optional/ungraded.
artifacts.findings: nonempty honest case-study interpretation; no mandated numerical outcome
artifacts.csv_additional_columns: Bounded descriptive extra columns allowed and ignored; all eight required columns retained

serialization.subject_and_axis_order: unique equivalent permutations accepted when values and evidence indices realign
serialization.selected_indices: Unique bounded finite non-Boolean value-integral indices, including exactly integral floats; set order free
serialization.numeric_dtypes: Safe finite real numeric storage accepted when all identity, shape, domain and conditioned-fidelity rules are preserved; no dtype fingerprint or blanket quantization guarantee
serialization.identity_integer_width_or_endianness: Any bounded finite non-Boolean value-integral numeric representation, including exactly integral floats
serialization.strings: bounded Unicode or valid UTF8 bytes
serialization.additional_arrays: Bounded finite non-object/non-structured/non-complex real numeric, Boolean or valid UTF8-string arrays may be ignored
serialization.additional_fields_files: Finite bounded descriptive JSON fields, CSV columns and regular files may be ignored; no extra value overrides required fields
